nodes.name: Fetch Agent Policy
nodes.notes: Policy source. neverError + alwaysOutputData so an absent personality reaches the gate as an empty result and is denied, instead of halting the branch and answering an empty 200.

nodes.name: Policy Gate
nodes.notes: Fail-closed. Every DENY is evaluated before any ALLOW, so missing or unrecognised input can only block.

nodes.name: Record Blocked
nodes.notes: Audit for the denied path. Writes risk class, autonomy level, reason, approval state and correlation id into the existing agent_actions row -- no new table, no secrets.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, executed: false, result: $('Policy Gate').item.json._status, policy: $('Policy Gate').item.json.policy_result }) }}

nodes.name: Respond Blocked
nodes.notes: 202: the request was understood and deliberately not executed. Distinct from a 4xx, which would imply the caller got something wrong.

nodes.name: Call Booking
nodes.notes: book_meeting arriving from MCP. Reached only after the Policy Gate allows it.
